title: Cork board, tiles and natural cork
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of cork: agglomerated granules with finer fragments, crevices, pores and pin holes, sealed cork floor tiles, dark expanded cork insulation, or natural cork with dark lenticels. Use for notice boards, floors, wall panels, coasters, stoppers and insulation.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python cork_board.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 agglomerated granules (boards, tiles), 1 natural cork with lenticels (stoppers, bark slabs).

parameters.name: granules
parameters.meaning: Granules across the tile width (agglomerated cork).

parameters.name: fragments
parameters.meaning: Visibility of the finer fragments inside the granules.

parameters.name: gaps
parameters.meaning: Depth and darkness of the crevices between granules.

parameters.name: pores
parameters.meaning: Density of fine pores (and of lenticels in natural cork).

parameters.name: pin_holes
parameters.meaning: Pin holes punched into the tile.

parameters.name: sealed
parameters.meaning: Varnish: fills pores, deepens the colour and adds gloss.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Notice-board cork: mixed granules with pin holes.

presets.name: floor_tile
presets.description: Fine sealed cork floor tile with a satin varnish.

presets.name: expanded_dark
presets.description: Heat-expanded black cork insulation: coarse dark granules, deep gaps.

presets.name: natural_stopper
presets.description: Natural cork as in a wine stopper: golden mass with dark lenticels.

limits: Granules are two warped cellular layers with per-cell tones, an approximation of pressed cork, and the lenticels of natural cork are thresholded stretched noise. Pin holes are round dark pits with a raised rim; no pins, paper or staples are drawn. The sealed finish is a colour and roughness change without a clear-coat layer. Details finer than two pixels are dropped at small sizes. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic.
technique_references: Two Worley layers on the torus for granules and fragments
Stretched value noise thresholded into lenticels
Elliptical stamps for pin holes with rims
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
